items.hypothesis: Initialize only KS3 warp coefficient c4 to -0.025 instead of zero at every dense and routed site. This adds 0.025 - 0.05*z^2 before squared ReLU, opening small activations and damping saturated ones while enabling warp gradients immediately. Test a modest learned-basis initialization change at unchanged width 1024, rank one, projection multiplier 1.0 and geometry Adam multiplier 0.125. Shared/model-wide settings stay frozen.

Increase only the five dense KS3 branches from 1024 to 1280 features, retaining routed expert width 1024 and rank one. Test an intermediate capacity and runtime tradeoff after the 1536-width trial was training-proxy-pruned; that earlier prune is not validation evidence. Keep original ANVIL shape-dependent scaling, geometry Adam multiplier 0.125, projection multiplier 1.0 and all shared/model-wide settings. Require the independent 1280-feature dense output/gradient oracle before training.

decision: Preserve the rank-four and geometry0.0625 queue and any required verification. Once the last predecessor run ID is available, create a queue that depends on its completed result. The new 1280-feature dense GPU oracle must pass before that discovery.
